protocol.analytic_public_controls: current/latest single-cue log odds from known public reliability semantics, no evaluation-label fitting; avoids weak frozen latest baseline trained on a neutral last cue. No accumulated-history oracle predictor used as model evidence
protocol.calibration: prediction=slope*oracle+intercept descriptive regression; R2, correlation and MAE; no evaluation-label calibration applied to predictions
protocol.channel_probes: six channels projected separately, descriptive decoding availability, not causal ownership or necessity
protocol.claim_boundary: locate frozen public-evidence calibration across order/time; not information erasure, causal memory ownership, calibrated uncertainty, learning or adaptation
protocol.controls: current and latest public encodings, schedule-only, and full-state conditional train-label shuffle within latest-symbol strata; reliability fixed within each order/time. Shuffle seed=model_seed*10000+fit_tick*100+projection_seed; retain changed-label count
protocol.decision_rule: For each primary time/order family, projected full-state R2 must exceed analytic latest and matched conditional-shuffle R2 in every declared projection and parameter seed for a seed/projection-robust comparative statement; otherwise mixed or unestablished. Within-order failure is probe availability failure, not erasure. No automatic hypothesis promotion.
protocol.falsifier: Within-order heldout-history projected-state decoding fails fair public/shuffle controls; cross-order and temporal calibration assessed separately, not conflated with availability.
protocol.fit_modes: time_refit: fit base-order train histories at each time, evaluate unseen histories in both orders. cue_end_frozen: fit only base-order train histories at cue6, evaluate the same heldout history IDs in both orders at each delay.
protocol.label: public prefix Bayesian reference log odds; no hidden target or resolve frame enters system
protocol.primary: Within-order unseen-history availability versus cross-order unseen-history transfer at each time; cue6-frozen heldout histories separately test temporal calibration.
protocol.public_control_identity: at evidence checkpoints current and latest semantic controls identical; learned latest remains deliberately train-support-limited
protocol.replication: Independent fresh parameter seeds, split83 and second reliability-order pair. Same projection seeds/dimension, ridge alpha, checkpoints, fair controls and all-cell criterion. No result-dependent tuning.
protocol.schedule_control_boundary: one-order schedule vector constant across histories; trivial negative sanity only, not substantive exclusion of schedule exploitation
protocol.scope: Four fresh independent parameter seeds; one frozen32/32 allocation, two fixed orders, histories, checkpoints, projections and channels dependent within seed. No interventions, new geometry sweep or architecture change.
protocol.state_diagnostics: order and cue6-reference centroid shifts, full/channel norms; raw-scale summaries non-causal
protocol.support: All64 full histories collected per order/seed/time; train32/eval32 split within train-order final-symbol and public log-odds-sign strata (zero tolerance1e-12). Same fixed heldout history IDs across orders/times/seeds; no fit/eval overlap.
